stem: How did press coverage of events during the Vietnam War affect the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: Film footage from the front lines increased congressional support for the war.

options.label: B
options.text: Reporting on military setbacks contributed to public disillusionment with the war.

options.label: C
options.text: Increased U.S. media presence overseas resulted in overwhelming international support for U.S. intervention.

options.label: D
options.text: Live presidential press conferences led to a decline in partisan politics in Congress.
